abstract: Thirty cases of struma ovarii with unusual microscopic features are described. They occurred in women 23 to 71 (average 49) years of age. Most of the patients had the usual symptoms and signs of an adnexal mass. Three patients had ascites and two had Meigs' syndrome. The tumors, all unilateral and confined to the ovary, ranged from 4 to 25 (average 12) cm in greatest dimension. They were typically predominantly solid and red-brown but cysts were present within foci of struma in several cases; an associated dermoid cyst was noted grossly in nine cases. Microscopic examination showed a prominent diffuse pattern in 21 cases, prominent microfollicles imparting in many cases a pseudotubular appearance in 20 cases, abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm in nine cases, and abundant clear cytoplasm in four cases. A contiguous dermoid cyst which had not been recognized on gross examination was documented in five cases. The typical paucity of thyroid follicles in cellular areas of these tumors often caused either a failure to consider a diagnosis of struma ovarii or led to serious consideration of other diagnoses. Clues to the correct diagnosis were the presence of rare typical thyroid follicles in foci that were predominantly diffuse or pseudotubular, the presence of larger areas of typical struma in 22 cases, and the association with a dermoid cyst in 14 cases. Immunohistochemical staining for thyroglobulin confirmed the nature of the tumor in all five cases in which it was performed. The diagnosis of struma should be entertained when one is examining an ovarian neoplasm with solid or pseudotubular patterns or a content of oxyphilic or clear cells. A careful search for thyroid follicles should be undertaken to establish the diagnosis and immunohistochemical staining for thyroglobulin performed to confirm it in problematic cases.
abstract_ja: 奇妙な顕微鏡的特徴を示す卵巣甲状腺腫30例を報告する。患者は23歳から71歳（平均49歳）の女性であった。大半は付属器腫瘤に典型的な症状・徴候を示した。3例に腹水、2例にMeigs症候群が認められた。腫瘍はすべて片側性で卵巣に限局し、最大径は4〜25 cm（平均12 cm）であった。肉眼的には多くが充実性で赤褐色を呈したが、数例では甲状腺組織の病巣内に嚢胞が存在した。類皮嚢腫が9例で肉眼的に認められた。顕微鏡検査では、びまん性パターンが21例で顕著、微小濾胞による偽管状外観が20例で顕著、好酸性細胞質に富むものが9例、明るい細胞質に富むものが4例であった。肉眼では認識されなかった隣接類皮嚢腫が5例で証明された。細胞成分の多い領域には典型的な甲状腺濾胞が乏しいため、卵巣甲状腺腫の診断が見落とされたり、他の診断が重視されたりすることがしばしばあった。診断の手がかりは、びまん性または偽管状パターンの領域に稀に存在する典型的な甲状腺濾胞、甲状腺組織がより広く認められる領域、そして類皮嚢腫の合併（14例）であった。充実性・偽管状パターンや好酸性または明るい細胞を含む卵巣腫瘍を検査する際には、卵巣甲状腺腫を考慮すべきである。診断の確定には甲状腺濾胞の注意深い探索が必要であり、問題症例ではサイログロブリンの免疫染色で確認すべきである。サイログロブリン免疫染色は、検討した5例すべてで腫瘍の性質を確認した。
